fullPassage: Until a few decades ago, most of the world's coffee and cocoa were shade-grown under a canopy of large forest trees. Recently, however, new varieties of both crops have been developed that can be grown in full sun. Because more coffee or cocoa trees can be crowded into these fields, and they get more solar energy than in a shaded plantation, yields for sun-grown crops are higher. There are costs, however, in this new technology. Sun-grown trees die earlier from the stress and diseases common in these fields. In addition, scientists have found that the number of bird species can be cut in half in full-sun plantations, and the number of individual birds may be reduced by 90 percent. Shade-grown coffee and cocoa generally require fewer pesticides because the birds and insects residing in the forest canopy eat many of the pests.

Recently, however, new varieties of both crops ②<u>have been developed</u> that ③<u>can be grown</u> in full sun. Because more coffee or cocoa trees can be crowded into these fields, and they get more solar energy than in a shaded plantation, yields for sun-grown crops ④<u>are higher</u>. In addition, scientists have found that the number of bird species can be cut in half in full-sun plantations, and the number of individual birds may be reduced by 90 percent. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① were shade-growing → were shade-grown: 커피와 코코아는 그늘 아래에서 '재배된' 대상이므로 수동의 과거분사 grown이 필요. growing(현재분사, 능동)은 태 오류.
det.analysis:
❌ ① were shade-growing → were shade-grown (커피/코코아는 재배되는 대상 → 수동 과거분사)
✅ ② have been developed: 현재완료 수동태 — 원문 일치
✅ ③ can be grown: 조동사 + be + p.p. — 원문 일치
✅ ④ are higher: 복수 주어 yields + 복수 be동사 — 원문 일치
det.tip: 수동태: be + p.p. grow의 p.p.는 grown

In addition, scientists have found that ①<u>the number of bird species</u> ②<u>can be cutting in half</u> in full-sun plantations, and the number of individual birds ③<u>may be reduced</u> ④<u>by 90 percent</u>. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② can be cutting → can be cut: 조동사 수동태 구조 'can + be + p.p.'에서 cut의 과거분사는 cut(동형). cutting(현재분사)은 수동형에 쓰일 수 없음.
det.analysis:
✅ ① the number of bird species: 'the number of + 복수명사'는 단수 취급 — 원문 일치
❌ ② can be cutting → can be cut (수동태는 be + p.p.. cut-cut-cut)
✅ ③ may be reduced: 조동사 + be + p.p. — 원문 일치
✅ ④ by 90 percent: 수동태 행위자 전치사 by + 수치 — 원문 일치
det.tip: 수동태: be + p.p. cut의 p.p.는 cut

questions.passage: Until a few decades ago, most of the world's coffee and cocoa were shade-grown under a canopy of large forest trees. Recently, however, new varieties of both crops have been developed that can be grown in full sun. Because more coffee or cocoa trees can be crowded into these fields, and they get more solar energy than in a shaded plantation, yields for sun-grown crops are higher. There are costs, however, in this new technology. Sun-grown trees die earlier from the stress and diseases common in these fields. In addition, scientists have found that the number of bird species can be cut in half in full-sun plantations, and the number of individual birds may be reduced by 90 percent. Shade-grown coffee and cocoa ④<u>generally require fewer pesticides</u> because ③<u>the birds and insects which</u> ①<u>residing in the forest canopy</u> ②<u>eat many of the pests</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ the birds and insects which → the birds and insects: 뒤의 residing(현재분사)이 명사를 수식하는 분사구로 이미 수식 관계가 성립되어 있음. 관계대명사 which를 추가하면 이중 수식이 되어 비문. 또는 which를 쓸 경우 뒤의 residing이 아닌 reside(정형동사)가 필요.
det.analysis:
✅ ① residing in the forest canopy: 현재분사구 후치 수식 — 원문 일치
✅ ② eat many of the pests: 복수 동사 + 목적어 — 원문 일치
❌ ③ the birds and insects which → the birds and insects (뒤 분사구 residing와 이중 수식. which 추가 시 정형동사 필요)
✅ ④ generally require fewer pesticides: 복수 동사 + 비교급 + 명사 — 원문 일치
det.tip: 분사구 수식 vs 관계절 수식은 양자택일. 둘 다 쓰면 비문

There are costs, however, in this new technology. Sun-grown trees die ③<u>earlier</u> from the stress and diseases common in these fields. In addition, scientists have found that the number of bird species can be cut in half in full-sun plantations, and the number of individual birds may be reduced by 90 percent. Shade-grown coffee and cocoa generally require ④<u>fewer</u> pesticides because the birds and insects residing in the forest canopy eat many of the pests.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① scattered → crowded: sun-grown 재배는 나무를 '밀집'시켜 더 많은 태양광을 받게 해 수확량이 증가한다는 논리. scattered(흩어진)는 정반대 — 공간 확보 의미로 밀집의 장점 논지와 충돌.
det.analysis:
❌ ① scattered → crowded (나무를 밀집시키는 것이 sun-grown의 이점. scattered는 반대)
✅ ② higher: 수확량이 더 높다 — 원문 일치
✅ ③ earlier: sun-grown 나무는 더 일찍 죽는다 — 원문 일치
✅ ④ fewer: 그늘 재배가 더 적은 농약 필요 — 원문 일치
det.tip: more trees crowded + more solar energy → higher yields

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② destroyed → developed: 최근 신품종이 '개발되어' 직사광선 아래 재배가 가능해졌다는 맥락. destroyed(파괴된)는 논지 정반대.
det.analysis:
✅ ① shade-grown: 그늘 재배된 — 원문 일치
❌ ② destroyed → developed (신품종이 개발되어 full sun 재배 가능. destroyed는 반대)
✅ ③ full sun: 직사광선 아래 재배 조건 — 원문 일치
✅ ④ solar energy: 태양광 — 원문 일치
